defects.quote: it is the current month or one of the 12 months before the current month.
defects.description: The 12-month limit is only stated and tested on the inside (October 2025, twelve months back); no rule says what happens for a month outside it, such as September 2025 (or a future month), and no scenario sits just past the limit.

defects.quote: Verified by: test that committee members can tell at a glance from the report which court is
defects.description: Court order's Verified by is a "test" of whether people can tell something at a glance, which only a person can judge and no test can carry out; it should test the listed order (or be a demonstration).
